stories.title: Ustica, la Francia è pronta a collaborare: si va verso lo stop all'archiviazione

en.title: Ustica, France is ready to collaborate: moving towards halting the dismissal
en.summary: French authorities have approved the transfer of documents related to legal requests in the Ustica case, with a government official noting progress has been made toward preventing the case from being closed.

stories.title: Attacco contro base della Raf, rilasciati su cauzione i 5 arrestati

en.title: Attack against RAF base, 5 arrested released on bail
en.summary: Five individuals arrested in connection with an attack on an RAF base have been released on bail with surveillance measures imposed while investigations continue.

stories.title: Il video dei salvataggi dalle finestre dell'Accademia delle Scienze di Kiev avvolta dalle fiamme

en.title: Video of rescues from windows of Kyiv Academy of Sciences engulfed in flames
en.summary: A drone attack on the Academy of Sciences building in Kyiv resulted in at least one death and 19 injuries, with the capital facing ongoing strikes from Russian drones and missiles.

stories.title: Denis Bergamini, nuovo indagato: notificato l’avviso al cugino dell’ex fidanzata del calciatore

en.title: Denis Bergamini, new person under investigation: notice served to cousin of footballer's ex-girlfriend
en.summary: A 65-year-old man named Roberto Internò has been registered as a person under investigation in the Bergamini case, with an appeal sentence for the footballer's former girlfriend scheduled for November 17.

stories.title: Perizia sulla morte di David Rossi: "Fu omicidio, aggredito da più persone, tentava di difendersi"

en.title: Autopsy on David Rossi death: "It was murder, attacked by multiple people, attempted to defend himself"
en.summary: A simulation ordered by a parliamentary inquiry commission suggests the former MPS communications chief was held outside a window by multiple attackers before losing his grip.

stories.title: Denis Bergamini, c'è un nuovo indagato per concorso in omicidio

en.title: Denis Bergamini: new suspect charged in connection with murder
en.summary: Prosecutors in Castrovillari notified a 65-year-old of preliminary investigation conclusions. An appellate ruling for the footballer's former partner is scheduled for November 17.

stories.title: Nuovo indagato per omicidio Denis Bergamini, notificato avviso

en.title: New suspect notified in Denis Bergamini murder case
en.summary: A 65-year-old has been notified in connection with the investigation. An appeal verdict regarding the footballer's ex-partner is expected on November 17.

stories.title: Ustica, Francia pronta a collaborare, pm verso il ritiro dell'archiviazione

en.title: Ustica: France ready to cooperate, prosecutors consider withdrawing closure
en.summary: The French embassy announced willingness to transmit documents related to the massacre, prompting prosecutors to reconsider archiving the investigation.

stories.title: Ustica, l’inchiesta non verrà archiviata: la Francia dopo 46 anni ha deciso di collaborare

en.title: Ustica, the investigation will not be archived: France has decided to cooperate after 46 years
en.summary: France has agreed to collaborate on the Ustica case after 46 years, prompting Rome's prosecutor to move ahead of a scheduled September 30 hearing to prevent archival of the investigation.

stories.title: Nuovo indagato per la morte di Denis Bergamini: notificato l’avviso all’ex cognato del calciatore

en.title: New suspect identified in death of Denis Bergamini: notice served on footballer's ex-brother-in-law
en.summary: A 65-year-old has been identified as a new suspect in the Denis Bergamini case, with an appeal verdict for the footballer's ex-girlfriend scheduled for November 17.

stories.title: Ustica, la Francia pronta a collaborare: i pm vogliono ritirare l’archiviazione del caso

en.title: Ustica, France ready to cooperate: prosecutors want to withdraw the case archival
en.summary: France has signaled its willingness to transmit documents related to the Ustica massacre, enabling prosecutors to reverse the archival of the investigation.

stories.title: Mps, morte David Rossi, la perizia: “Aggredito da più persone, tentava di difendersi”

en.title: Mps, death of David Rossi, expert assessment: "Attacked by multiple people, tried to defend himself"
en.summary: An expert simulation commissioned by an inquiry commission concludes that David Rossi was attacked by multiple people while attempting self-defense and was held out of a window, determining the death was a homicide.

en.title: Work-life balance certification launches
en.summary: Certifying bodies authorized to issue work-life balance attestations to companies are being announced today. Companies can receive tax relief of up to 50,000 euros annually for family-friendly workplace policies.

stories.title: Scatto dell’export extra-Ue, con Svizzera, Cina e Usa

en.title: Surge in exports outside EU, with Switzerland, China and USA
en.summary: Italian exports to non-EU countries grew 16.1 percent year-over-year in August, driven notably by increased shipments to Switzerland, China, and the United States.

stories.title: Nell’avanzata digitale gli incontri reali acquistano valore

en.title: In digital advancement, in-person meetings gain value
en.summary: The third edition of the States General of Events highlighted how physical gatherings are becoming increasingly valuable amid ongoing digital transformation.

stories.title: Avatar, mascotte e gemelli: il mondo delle persone sintetiche

en.title: Avatars, mascots and twins: the world of synthetic people
en.summary: Artificial intelligence is evolving from a creative tool into a decision-making infrastructure, enabling new models for testing and interaction between brands and consumers.

stories.title: Benzina e diesel, anche Ip fisserà limiti ai prezzi

en.title: Petrol and diesel, Ip will also set price limits
en.summary: Socar is following Eni's example by implementing price caps on petrol and diesel across its Ip distribution network.
